title: Greywater reuse boundary for flushing and cleaning
summary: A household boundary for reusing rinse water, shower water, or captured non-drinking water during shortages without contaminating food, hands, or children’s areas.
content: Core sequence: 1) Label greywater containers as not for drinking and keep them below drinking-water containers. 2) Use greywater only for toilet flushing, first-stage floor rinsing, or outdoor dust control where runoff will not reach food areas. 3) Never store warm greywater for long; use it quickly or discard it before odor, slime, insects, or confusion appear. 4) Wash hands with safe water after handling greywater containers or splash areas.
